result.planSummary: Addressed the three verifier findings by making PI runtime capture resolve the managed Thread for the current session target, forwarding active branch context through `/lh-fixture pi-session`, and preserving source session cwd in PI-session fixture imports. Added focused regression coverage for cross-session capture, branched command fixture creation, and imported fixture cwd fidelity, then ran targeted tests plus both required gates.

changedFiles.reason: Made activeThread cache target-aware, added active leaf/sessionManager propagation for `/lh-fixture pi-session`, and kept command execution routed through structured command results.
Exposed source session cwd from SessionManager so import consumers can preserve real session metadata.
Used imported session cwd when creating imported Thread target metadata and runtime import context.
Stopped defaulting PI-session fixture imports to dirname(sessionFilePath) and allowed import-service to preserve source session cwd.
Kept missing session-file paths usable for target key derivation by falling back to resolved paths when realpath is unavailable.
Added command result formatting used by Story 7 command handlers.
Added the project extension entrypoint that re-exports the Context Steward PI extension.
Added regression coverage proving production PI handlers create separate managed Threads for distinct session targets.
Updated PI-session fixture coverage to assert target cwd fidelity from source session metadata.
Added regression coverage proving `/lh-fixture pi-session` imports the active branch from the live session manager.

added: production PI handlers resolve a fresh managed thread when the PI session target changes
/lh-fixture pi-session imports the active branch from the live session manager
modified: creates a fixture from a PI session import without creating a managed thread

findingsFixed: story-7-extension-cross-session-thread-cache: ensureActiveThread now checks the current PI target before reusing activeThread and opens/creates the correct managed Thread when the session target changes.
story-7-fixture-command-misses-active-branch: `/lh-fixture pi-session` now forwards activeLeafId and a compatible sessionManager into createRealSessionFixture.
story-7-pi-session-fixture-cwd-drift: PI-session fixture imports now preserve SessionManager.getCwd() through readPiActivePath and attachExistingPiSession instead of using dirname(sessionFilePath).

result.recommendedNextStep: Run the Story 7 verifier again against the updated implementation.
